title: CPC Validation
description: CPC Validation is the reference validation framework for Constraint Physical Computing (CPC), with canonical constraint IR, RC, Digital and FPGA backends, independent semantic validation and physical-evidence contracts. Version 0.7.0 includes RFC-0010 open-system software, CPC-SHOR finite simulations, bounded P3/P4 software, N0 pre-physical tooling, and the bounded classical UP5K/Pico probability/PRNG milestone for seeded physical oracle records 2, 68 and 194. Historical RFC-0009 P1 evidence remains a separate lineage. Known physical error-path discrepancies remain unresolved. Physical N0 quantum execution, physical Shor factorization, scalable quantum computing, quantum advantage and ASI containment are not demonstrated.
